title: React to a Route Parameter
short_description: Render the correct profile and update it when Vue Router's dynamic parameter changes.
description: The environment already configures a /users/:id route and App.vue provides navigation between profiles.
Complete UserProfile.vue to read the current id through useRoute and reactively derive the visible user.
instructions: Use the route instance provided by useRoute.
Inside computed, find the users entry whose id matches route.params.id.
Convert the parameter to a string before comparing it.
Keep the profile-not-found state for unknown identifiers.
You only need to modify UserProfile.vue.

hints.title: Reactive route
hints.body: Read `route.params.id` inside `computed` so the profile updates when the URL changes.

hints.title: No match
hints.body: `find` returns `undefined` when no profile exists; the template already uses that result to render the empty state.
